kind: WordPress public attachment detail-page backlog, source URL read-only metadata
notes: All 270 remaining WordPress attachment-page addresses are fail-closed. Direct paid-media download paths are deliberately omitted. Eight protected WooCommerce WAV attachments and four public DEMO MP3 attachment records linked to positive-price downloadable products have their source URLs/filenames redacted. The previous 'two copies of protected files' characterization was incorrect. Six other DEMO attachment pages remain held for rights/duration review and two are blocked due to a truncated 2088-byte original. Image groups are filename-based provisional classifications, not an authorization to publish.
